notes.title: Update March 13th 2025 (Version 0.4.03)
notes.notes:
It's again time for another round of bug fixes with some new additions!

Task Deeply Insane is now completable

We have good for those who were left hanging after talking to Laura Markkanen! You can now talk with her and pick up where you left off in the Deeply Insane task.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/f8e1a7fec6d7879148b13e12587d1ee7997308ed.png

Notebook

We have added a notebook item where you can write whatever you want.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/369c4d30a226a6630a58a169d43e719dc4b3a9b5.png

New items and recipes

We’ve added several new items, including toilet paper, bacteria colony, agar, and grapes! Toilet paper prevents hygiene loss from toilet use, and you can purchase a 6-pack from O-market. And of course, with grapes, you can create grape mash or grape mushroom mash.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/601e40469a0f58579b2a6addf7b323dfe3682c07.png

 Added NPC reactions to being hit by the player
 Added some furniture storage to spawn items when placed on the stairwell
 Improved loading times
 The maximum prison sentence gets longer each time the player lands in prison
 Fixed miners paying 4% instead of 20%.
 Fixed light zones not always working correctly, which caused lag
 Fixed typo in doctor's addiction status text (issue #3778)

notes.title: Update February 7th 2025 (Version 0.4.02)
notes.notes:
Hello, landlords and myco-excavators, it's time for another round of bug fixes with some new additions!

Gas Mask

The Gas Mask is a new item that protects you from mushroom spores longer than a regular face mask.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/5097a81ee48a340edfe85fd68074e983bab30582.png

New Task

A new task was added where you have to find a specific minitrain miniature for Mikkel, and he’ll help you with minitrain speed camera!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/8da2e3f6d4b789ae7f6ccdb54d213605ee85d1a7.png

Furniture Console Commands

Three new console commands have been added for managing furniture:

 add_furniture – Adds a specific piece of furniture
 add_furniture_all – Adds all furniture at once

 Consuming orange mushroom powder now speeds up working speed on manual machines.

notes.title: Mines update is out now!
notes.notes:
Well, the Mines update is out now for ya.

[previewyoutube=DPJHV2pzhKI;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is now on sale, after which the price will increase. So now is a great time to grab it if ya don't have it already.

Major points from the changelog:

 Many new areas, including the new Mines District.
 Minitrain system.
 Liquid storage system.
 New full-length story quests
 Glowstick Trail, Orange Heaven and Getting a Passport quests are now fully completable
 Overhauled character models for: Malone P., Tatyana G., H. Mobelmann, Amanda K., Sara C., Vivi B. and Patrik A.
 Added consequences for choosing Crazy Neighbour and the police as a threat in the starting choices
 Readable literature, including newspapers, magazines and books
 New chains of alcohol production
 New branches of crafting, including sewing and electronics, both with 2 tiers of machines and associated skills
 The addition of Drawing Table that allows you to craft furniture blueprints, including unique ones
 Vendors now shown an indicator of their current wealth
 Player stats tab, currently showing the skill levels player has
 Reworked backpacks now each working as a separate inventory, as well as the addition of new types of backpacks
 New animal types, including cats and chickens, as well as new fish types
 Multiple new furniture available to buy and craft
 Multiple new gameplay mechanics, machines, recipes, tenement upgrades, vendors and such tied with the mines
 Fixed a bug with solid-fuel machines having unusable fuel slots


The full changelog can be read here:
https://github.com/loiste-interactive/Obenseuer-Issues/blob/main/CHANGES.md

As there may be some issues when coming from old versions, it's always possible to roll back to previous versions. Workshop, Shroomcave and basement upgrades should be completed before coming to the new mines version, as their contractor changes in the update.

Version 0.3.38 can still be accessed via: Steam Library -> Obenseuer -> Options -> Betas and selecting 0.3.38.

notes.title: Update March 14th 2024 (Version 0.3.35)
notes.notes:
Hello,

Time for another update of bugfixes and a few additions for Obenseuer.

Difficulty settings

You can now select a custom difficulty where you can change several settings such as needs speed, renovation cost, and addiction recovery speed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/a2d90376c7dda70a39768a82b7c749692e53f054.jpg

Hygiene and radiation

Two new stats have been added.

The hygiene which decreases slowly, but you can use the shower to wash yourself. Too low hygiene exposes you to fungal disease.

The radiation is hidden stat, which can be checked by Dr. Pena or using a dosimeter, which you will need in the mines. Also pharmacy now sells iodine pills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/b447e3b893151df97149105cdecc9406c2ed47bf.jpg

Sleeping events

There are several different types of sleeping events, such as the police can take you to jail or someone can infect you with a fungal disease.

Mask slot and dishwasher

There is currently one item for the face slot, a face mask which provides protection against fungi. Face masks can be bought at the pharmacy. A dirty mask also quickly reduces hygiene.

Dishwasher can be used to wash away the owner of the items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/22e187b9e1bb42fe3c98040a404cff950c8e84f2.jpg

Other additions and changes


 Added ability to move items quickly by holding down the mouse button
 Added processing time for crafting furniture
 Added a second autosave slot
 Added ability to remove save slots
 Increased spoilage times
 Increased farming payment
 Increased mash payment
 Rebalanced renovation costs
 Police respawn to their original positions


Also here are some pictures of future updates:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/ba5bd67708771a89870ddfba3eccf9f6eb3499fb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/0f455e7c6908f5a813e3af92104be2f516bfc16f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/3bcb772363a5b9f00a6273eb2e91dd09dda144a7.png

Full changelog can be read here:
https://github.com/loiste-interactive/Obenseuer-Issues/blob/main/CHANGES.md

notes.notes:
Patch notes for December 22nd 2023 (Version 0.3.26)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/fe3e7421d5dfd71a66c85de651c6c083bc264d73.jpg

Hello mycomancers, moonshiners and landlords,

Today we have some fairly decently sized chunk of additions and bug fixes for Obenseuer.

Starting from the most major one:

Ability to clean up other apartments and public areas

Now all the clutter in the stairwell, public areas and apartments can be picked and cleaned up in a newly added cleaning mode. Collecting all the leftover furniture will give healthy starting boost for business.
To balance it, contractor now requires apartments to be mostly cleaned up before starting any upgrades, and getting rid of those nasty mushroom infestations requires some cleaning chemicals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/1b7c2499ccdbde7770ff911a0e7486532ba09bd4.jpg
On top of furniture collecting and cleaning, you can now place furniture on stairwell.

Map markers

Or more like map stickers.  Discovering a noteworthy location will now add a marker sticker on the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/2ba28fc4036bcd9f6967e688093587ddd749e05f.jpg

Job(s)

Patch notes for December 5th 2023 (Version 0.3.22)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/1a5bc5bea1b8df6c79849eaf1c3dc028cb7325b7.png

Hello,

Time for another regular(-ish) update of bugfixes and a few additions for Obenseuer.

This update adds new purchasable machine for filling empty gas bottles used at metallurgy, a makeshift biogas reactor, fill it with compostable matter (other than moldy waste) and turn on the compressor to fill out the gas bottle.

We also added new purchasable/craft-able machines for alcohol production:
a malter, electric mash kettle, cheap fermenting bucket and a high grade fermenting container. For home brewers, yeast can now be made in chemical lab from mashes and dough.

We also added some new options for accommodating different keyboard layouts - movement keys can now be re-assigned. There's also new options for game display modes and background behavior.


Full changelog can be read here:
https://github.com/loiste-interactive/Obenseuer-Issues/blob/main/CHANGES.md

Also, previous 0.3.21 version can still be accessed from: Steam library -> Obenseuer -> Options -> Betas and selecting 0.3.21

notes.title: Development update

As some of you may already know,  Obenseuer has been in semi-closed playtesting for a some months, and we have made steady progress on quashing bugs, implementing last pieces of missing content and polishing the game. We're close of reaching the point where the all planned features and content of the overhaul are completed and polished, allowing us to release the overhauled game to the public.

notes.title: A small status update

It's been a long time since we actually updated the game or even made any posts about the process, so we thought that we own you guys one.

As you already should know, the game is being completely refactored and overhauled with goals of upgrading graphics, adding new content and especially optimizing the game – to get rid of that terrible terrible FPS ruining everything!

However it would still take quite a time the update is in releasable condition.

But anyway, here's new (and relatively new, as some of you may have seen new pictures being occasionally posted) content to show:

Upcoming: Custom furniture placement

The Open Sewer district has been split into separate zones with different main functions.
